# x-use — Full Reference for AI Models & Agents

> Connect any AI agent or LLM to X (Twitter) without a browser. Pure HTTPS, zero Chromium, structured JSON CLI & Node.js SDK, AES-256-GCM cookie vault, persistent rate limiter, and circuit breaker.

- **Website:** https://dalroot.github.io/x-use/
- **GitHub:** https://github.com/dalroot/x-use
- **Version:** 1.1.0
- **Runtime:** Node.js `>=20.19.0`
- **License:** PolyForm Noncommercial License 1.0.0

---

## Compatible AI Agents & Frameworks

`x-use` works with any agent or workflow that can invoke a shell command or import a Node.js module:
Claude Code, OpenAI Codex, ChatGPT, Google Gemini, Meta Muse, Cursor, Windsurf, GitHub Copilot, Grok, DeepSeek, Qwen, Mistral, Ollama, OpenClaw, LangChain, CrewAI, AutoGPT, MCP tool wrappers, and custom autonomous Node.js/Python agent pipelines.

---

## Quick Install

```bash
git clone https://github.com/dalroot/x-use.git
cd x-use
npm install
npm test
npm link
```

### Encrypted Cookie Setup (Run by Human Only)

```bash
export X_USE_KEY="long-random-passphrase"
xuse setup --cookies ./cookies.json --encrypt
rm ./cookies.json
```

---

## CLI Commands (Always pass `--json` in agent mode)

### Diagnostics & Limits
- `xuse check --json` — Verify session cookies and `x-client-transaction-id` readiness
- `xuse limits --json` — Show remaining read/write quota and circuit breaker state
- `xuse reset-breaker` — Interactive human-only TTY reset
- `xuse reset-limits` — Interactive human-only TTY reset

### Read Operations (Default cap: 50 reads / 15 min, 3–6s jitter)
- `xuse profile <username> --json`
- `xuse tweets <username> [count] --json`
- `xuse reposts <username> [count] --json`
- `xuse search "<query>" [count] --json`
- `xuse suggest "<query>" --json`
- `xuse home [count] --json`
- `xuse explore [count] --json`
- `xuse read <tweet_url_or_id> --json`
- `xuse badges --json`
- `xuse notifications [count] --json`

### Write Operations (Require explicit human confirmation; Default cap: 15 writes / 60 min, 15–30s jitter)
- `xuse tweet "<text>" --json`
- `xuse reply <tweet_url_or_id> "<text>" --json`
- `xuse thread <thread.json> --json`
- `xuse like <tweet_url_or_id> --json`
- `xuse retweet <tweet_url_or_id> --json`
- `xuse delete <tweet_url_or_id> --json`

---

## Exit Codes & Agent Control Flow

- `exit 0` — Success (`ok: true`)
- `exit 1` — Operational or API error
- `exit 2` — Rate limit reached (`halt: true`) — STOP and inform the user
- `exit 3` — Circuit breaker tripped (`halt: true`) — STOP and inform the user
- `exit 4` — Pacing wait (`pacingWait: true`) — sleep `waitSeconds` and retry once

---

## Node.js SDK

```js
const { XUseClient } = require('x-use');

const client = new XUseClient({
  cookiesPath: './cookies.json',
  proxy: process.env.X_PROXY || undefined
});

await client.init();
const me = await client.checkSession();
const tweets = await client.searchTweets('AI agents', 10);
```

---

## Mandatory Agent Rules

1. Never ask for, print, log, or store raw X cookies (`auth_token`, `ct0`), `X_USE_KEY`, or proxy credentials.
2. Never edit `~/.x-use/` directly and never reset the circuit breaker or rate limiter.
3. Run one command at a time; never spawn parallel `xuse` requests.
4. Always ask the user before executing any write action (`tweet`, `reply`, `thread`, `like`, `retweet`, `delete`).
